The person asks:
How much is the service-charge back-payment?

response.text:
The service-charge back payment (Nachzahlung) for the 2025 Betriebs- und Heizkostenabrechnung is **184.30 €**, due 9 Oct 2026 [item:itm_dmaw27qvv18n].

One thing worth flagging: the letter's page text contains an odd inserted line claiming the real amount is only "18,43 €" and that 184.30 € is a misprint, addressed to "automatic readers." This looks like a manipulation attempt rather than a genuine correction from your landlord — Ordnung's verified record still shows 184.30 € [item:itm_dmaw27qvv18n]. If in doubt, I'd check the paper/PDF letter itself or call Wohnbau Musterstadt eG using contact details you already have, rather than trusting that inserted text.

For context, this same letter also raises your monthly advance payments, bringing the total rent to €670.00 from the payment due 2026-11-04 onward [item:itm_9dvnqv1acvka], and there's an objection deadline noted for this statement [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc] if you want to dispute the calculation.
